meta.title: Expense Management for Digital Agencies | Expendesk
meta.description: Track project budgets and client billing with precision. Expense management built for digital agencies and creative teams.

description: Stop losing margin to untracked spend. Expendesk lets agencies link every expense to a project and client — so billing is accurate and profitability is always clear.

items.title: Project-Level Budgets
items.desc: Assign budgets per project or client and get alerts before you go over.

items.title: Client Billing Sync
items.desc: Tag expenses as billable or non-billable and export directly to invoices.

items.title: Team Spend Cards
items.desc: Issue virtual cards to team members with pre-set limits per campaign.
